blurb: Guests ride premium fast jet cars that combine the design of a luxury supercar with the agility of a jet ski. The experience offers a unique way to explore the Thousand Islands waters. Launch is directly from Edgewood Resort in Alexandria Bay with parking and guest access available.

quotes.text: This was hands down the most exciting thing we did all summer! The JetCar is like a sports car on water — fast, smooth, and a total head-turner. Altmann Aquatics made the whole experience super easy and safe. We’ll be back!
